cases.prompt:
Assess this already authorized isolated mutation experiment on handwritten `src/auth/mayApprove.ts`. Contract: deny suspended actors and non-`pending` invoices; allow `finance_admin` for any pending invoice; otherwise allow only a `manager` with matching organization and `approvalLimitCents >= amountCents`; deny everyone else. Schema-validated inputs include strict-boolean `suspended`. Source boundary only:
`export function mayApprove(actor:Actor,invoice:Invoice){if(actor.suspended===true)return false;if(invoice.status!=="pending")return false;if(actor.roles.includes("finance_admin"))return true;return actor.roles.includes("manager")&&actor.orgId===invoice.orgId&&invoice.amountCents<=actor.approvalLimitCents;}`
Existing tests: pending finance-admin allow; same-org manager below limit; wrong-org manager deny; employee deny. Missing: suspended admin, non-pending invoice, exact limit, and employee otherwise satisfying manager conditions. Baselines: `pnpm vitest run src/auth/mayApprove.test.ts` passed 4/4 in 0.8s on 3 consecutive runs; required `pnpm test` passed 214/214 in 18s. Recent history: 2 authorization regressions in 6 months—suspended-admin bypass and `<` replacing `<=`.
Tooling: StrykerJS 8.7, Vitest runner, TypeScript checker. Owner authorized a clean-worktree, no-network run limited to this file and conditional/equality/boolean operators, 2 workers, 60s wall time, 0 retries. Generated code and integration boundaries excluded.
Initial run: 12 mutants; 7 killed, 5 survived. Survivors: suspended-guard deletion; status-guard deletion; `<=`→`<`; manager-role predicate→`true`; `actor.suspended===true`→`actor.suspended!==false`. The first 4 expose, respectively, missing suspended-admin, non-pending, exact-limit, and matching-org employee scenarios: valuable behavior gaps. The fifth is equivalent under the versioned strict-boolean schema. Sampled killed mutant org equality→inequality failed the existing same-org test, supporting useful tool behavior.
Trial improvements: 4 behavior-focused tests for those valuable survivors passed 8/8 with originals in 0.95s; each selected mutant was rerun individually and killed. The schema-supported equivalent was excluded; 0 survivors remain untriaged. Working tree was restored clean; no generated mutation patches retained.
Report classification counts, not only score; tie each test to the observable contract; decide whether this bounded exercise improved confidence. Do not claim completeness or recommend a universal threshold.
